protected_access_evidence.method: sys.addaudithook: every Python-process file open ('open' events) and every subprocess launch ('subprocess.Popen' events: executable, arguments, working directory) is checked against the resolved protected locations; opens performed inside external subprocesses are NOT observed, so subprocess commands and their path arguments are recorded and git's local paths are confined to the store

yield.note: admission yield precedes native qualification (Phase 3); it is an upper bound on the mined-to-qualified yield
